inputs.prompt: Same drone as the image. Change only the four arm roots: make the arm-to-body transitions smoother. Keep the nose, the forward camera and the four motor positions unchanged. Strict top view.
inputs.negative_prompt: flat schematic, line drawing, collage, text, labels, logo, cropped rotor, disconnected arm, extra rotor, perspective camera, V-shaped propeller, blades at an acute angle, single-blade propeller, missing blade, unequal blades, camera lens visible from above, upward-facing lens, camera on a neck or stalk, camera on a post
